name: Assess Mutation Test Value
summary: Use bounded mutation testing to expose weak assertions while separating equivalent and irrelevant mutants.
description: Plan or assess a bounded mutation-testing exercise by selecting consequential code, defining budgets, triaging survivors, and improving observable assertions. Use when coverage is high but test effectiveness remains uncertain.
risk_reason: This skill uses bounded mutation testing to expose weak assertions while separating equivalent and irrelevant mutants; it does not claim effective tests from line coverage, killed-mutant counts, or one tool run alone.
refuses: It does not optimize for a universal mutation-score threshold or add assertions that mirror implementation details.
It does not commit generated mutations, silence survivors broadly, or classify difficult cases as equivalent without evidence.
It does not claim effective tests from line coverage, killed-mutant counts, or one tool run alone.

operational.latency_reason: The skill uses bounded mutation testing to expose weak assertions while separating equivalent and irrelevant mutants, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
